titleZh: 宇树科技发布 As2 四足机器人
summaryZh: 宇树科技官方时间线记载，公司于 2026 年 2 月 24 日发布 As2 四足机器人。页面称其空载续航超过四小时、负载 15 千克时连续运行超过 2.5 小时，并面向工业应用提供开放的二次开发生态。
excerpt: Year of 2026 ... On February 24, Unitree launched the As2 quadruped robot.
gaps: The official timeline supports the event date, but the page itself has no publication date.
Performance figures are vendor-reported and not independently validated.

titleZh: Figure 宣布 Series C 承诺资本超过 10 亿美元
summaryZh: Figure 于 2025 年 9 月 16 日宣布，其 Series C 融资获得超过 10 亿美元的承诺资本，投后估值为 390 亿美元。公司表示资金将用于扩大 Helix、BotQ 制造、真实环境部署以及数据与算力基础设施。
excerpt: September 16, 2025 ... exceeded more than $1 billion in committed capital through our Series C financing round.
gaps: The page says committed capital; it does not establish that the full amount had been received or closed.

titleZh: Skild AI 完成 14 亿美元 Series C 融资
summaryZh: Skild AI 于 2026 年 1 月 14 日宣布已融资 14 亿美元，由软银领投，估值超过 140 亿美元。公司称新资金将扩大数据来源、基础研究和能够产生经济价值的真实世界部署。
excerpt: Jan 14, 2026 ... we have raised $1.4 billion ... led by SoftBank.
gaps: Financing and deployment claims are first-party statements and not independently validated here.

titleZh: Apptronik 宣布 5.2 亿美元 Series A-X 扩展轮
summaryZh: Apptronik 于 2026 年 2 月 11 日宣布 5.2 亿美元 Series A-X 扩展轮，使其 Series A 总额超过 9.35 亿美元。公司称这笔新资金将用于扩大 Apollo 人形机器人生产，并扩展商业及试点部署网络。
excerpt: February 11, 2026 ... announced a $520 million Series A-X funding round.
gaps: The $935M figure is cumulative Series A, not a second standalone round; deployment expansion is prospective.

titleZh: 逐际动力完成 2 亿美元 Series B 融资
summaryZh: 逐际动力于 2026 年 2 月 2 日宣布获得 2 亿美元 Series B 融资，多家境内外投资者参与。公司称将利用融资推进研发、全球市场扩张，以及机器人硬件、运动控制基础模型和 Agentic OS 三项技术支柱。
excerpt: Press February 2, 2026 ... secured $200 million USD in Series B financing.
gaps: Investor and use-of-proceeds details are company-reported.

titleZh: 小鹏机器人业务签署逾 9 亿美元融资协议
summaryZh: 小鹏汽车于 2026 年 8 月 24 日宣布，其机器人业务已与多名投资者签署股份购买协议，拟融资超过 9 亿美元，投后估值超过 63 亿美元。公告将该资金明确归属于小鹏机器人业务，并称资金将用于人形机器人量产与 Physical AI 模型研发。
excerpt: August 24, 2026 ... robotics business has entered into share purchase agreements ... raising over US$900 million.
gaps: The release supports signed agreements, not receipt of all proceeds or closing; capital must not be attributed to the automotive parent generally.

titleZh: NVIDIA 发布 Isaac GR00T 开放人形机器人参考设计
summaryZh: NVIDIA 于 2026 年 5 月 31 日发布 Isaac GR00T 人形机器人参考设计，整合 Unitree H2 Plus、Sharpa Wave 五指手、Jetson Thor 计算平台及 Isaac GR00T 软件。官方称多所研究机构将采用该设计，但整机要到 2026 年晚些时候才由宇树提供。
excerpt: May 31, 2026 ... announced ... the first open humanoid robot reference design.

fields.product: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T Reference Humanoid Robot

gaps: This is a reference-design announcement; commercial availability was future-dated, not completed on publication day.

titleZh: Hugging Face 发布 LeRobot v0.5.0
summaryZh: Hugging Face 于 2026 年 3 月 9 日刊发博文介绍 LeRobot v0.5.0。该版本增加 Unitree G1 全身控制支持、Pi0-FAST 与实时分块等策略、流式视频编码、EnvHub 和 IsaacLab-Arena 集成；正文未另列版本发布日。
excerpt: Published March 9, 2026 ... LeRobot v0.5.0 adds full Unitree G1 humanoid support.
gaps: The page explicitly supports only its publication date, not a separate release event date.
Capabilities are described by the vendor/project and were not independently benchmarked in this review.

titleZh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics 2 系列模型
summaryZh: Google DeepMind 于 2026 年 7 月 30 日发布 Gemini Robotics 2，覆盖全身控制、灵巧操作和多机器人协作。页面同时说明 ER 2 已可在 Google AI Studio 使用，而 VLA 与 On-Device 模型仅向早期合作伙伴开放。
excerpt: July 30, 2026 ... Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.

fields.availability: ER 2 public developer access; VLA and On-Device early-access partners

gaps: Performance results are first-party research evaluations; VLA availability is restricted rather than general.

titleZh: Intrinsic 加入 Google 并保留独立团队形态
summaryZh: Intrinsic 于 2026 年 2 月 25 日宣布已经加入 Google。公司表示将作为 Google 内的独立团队继续发展 Intrinsic 平台，并与 Google DeepMind、Gemini 和 Cloud 团队合作。
excerpt: February 25, 2026 ... we have joined Google ... As a distinct group within Google.
gaps: The page does not disclose transaction value or legal closing mechanics.

titleZh: ANYbotics 与 GE Vernova 扩展自主能源巡检合作
summaryZh: ANYbotics 于 2025 年 12 月 9 日披露与 GE Vernova 的能源巡检合作，将 ANYmal 自主巡检平台与 GE Vernova APM 软件和 AWS 云基础设施结合。官方案例称合作已从现场测试推进到 EMEA 的线上部署，并在以色列一座电厂完成自主机器人集成测试。
excerpt: From field tests to live deployments in the EMEA region ... successfully integrated ANYbotics’ autonomous robot at a power plant.

fields.status: vendor-reported live deployments and successful test

gaps: The page supports publication date but gives no exact deployment date, fleet size, or named live-deployment sites; claims are vendor-reported rather than independently validated.

titleZh: NEURA Robotics 宣布最高 14 亿美元 Series C 融资
summaryZh: NEURA Robotics 于 2026 年 6 月 10 日宣布一轮总规模最高 14 亿美元的 Series C 融资。公司称资金将推动认知机器人和人形机器人的全球部署、Neuraverse 扩张、NEURA Gyms 建设及制造基础设施扩容。
excerpt: June 10, 2026 ... announced a landmark Series C financing with a total round size of up to $1.4 billion.
gaps: The release says 'up to $1.4 billion'; it does not establish that $1.4B had been received at announcement.

titleZh: Wandercraft 与 SAPA 签署 Calvin-40 部署合作
summaryZh: Wandercraft 与 SAPA 于 2025 年 11 月 12 日宣布部署合作，计划在 SAPA 工业运营中实施并扩大 Calvin-40 人形机器人部署。公告明确称相关部署是计划中的安排，因此不能视为机器人已经在 SAPA 完成生产部署。
excerpt: November 12, 2025 ... announced a Deployment Partnership to implement and scale deployment of Calvin-40.
gaps: No completed deployment date, robot count, or operating results are stated on the page.

titleZh: Meta 开源视觉模型进入 RAMMP 辅助机器人原型
summaryZh: Meta 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日披露，匹兹堡大学 HERL 与 ATDev 的 RAMMP 辅助移动与操作平台正在使用 DINO 和 Segment Anything 等开源视觉模型。页面称首个原型已集成基于 DINO 的目标查询功能并准备开展真实世界测试，但 RAMMP 仍是研发项目而非已完成商业部署。
excerpt: This functionality is already being integrated by the RAMMP team into their first prototype.
gaps: Only the page date is explicit; no separate integration event date is given. The work is partner-led and vendor-reported, not an independently validated production deployment.

titleZh: FedEx 与 Dexterity 扩大 Hagerstown 枢纽自动装车部署
summaryZh: Dexterity 于 2026 年 7 月 30 日宣布与 FedEx 扩大合作，在马里兰州 Hagerstown 枢纽部署 Foresight 世界模型和 Mech 拖车装载系统。官方称该项目建立在多年联合开发、测试和运营验证基础上，并从此前试点站点扩展到更大运营规模。
excerpt: July 30, 2026 ... announced an expanded collaboration ... at the FedEx Hagerstown Hub.
gaps: The page does not disclose robot count or throughput results; deployment characterization is vendor-reported.

titleZh: Agility Robotics 与丰田加拿大签署 Digit 机器人服务协议
summaryZh: Agility Robotics 于 2026 年 2 月 19 日宣布，丰田加拿大在成功试点后已签署机器人即服务商业协议。丰田加拿大计划在其设施部署 Digit，用于制造、供应链和物流业务；公告同时称 Digit 当时已在开展工作，但没有披露新增部署数量。
excerpt: Following a successful pilot ... the companies have signed a Robots-as-a-Service agreement.

fields.deployment: 成功试点后签署机器人即服务协议，后续设施部署仍为计划
fields.status: commercial agreement signed; further deployment planned

gaps: The page does not disclose robot count or a date for the planned facility deployments.
The successful pilot and signed agreement must not be presented as completion of the planned expansion.

titleZh: 智元第 10,000 台通用具身机器人正式下线
summaryZh: 智元机器人官方文章于 2026 年 3 月 31 日发布，并明确远征 A3 作为公司第 10,000 台通用具身机器人已于 3 月 28 日下线。该数字是智元通用具身机器人的累计量产下线里程碑，不能解释为售出、交付或部署了 10,000 台远征 A3。
excerpt: 智元第10,000台通用具身机器人远征A3已于3月28日正式下线。

fields.productionMilestone: 第 10,000 台通用具身机器人累计量产下线

gaps: The source does not establish 10,000 A3 units sold, delivered, or deployed to customers.
The production count is vendor-reported and not independently validated here.

source: X Square Robot official news release
titleZh: 自变量机器人完成连续四轮融资，估值超过 28 亿美元
summaryZh: 自变量机器人于 2026 年 7 月 1 日宣布已完成并交割连续四轮融资，最终轮次为 Series C。官方将公司估值表述为超过 28 亿美元、即 200 亿元人民币，但没有披露四轮融资的合计金额或各轮金额。
excerpt: announced the closing of four consecutive financing rounds culminating in a Series C, bringing its valuation to over US$2.8 billion

fields.round: 连续四轮融资，最终轮次为 Series C

gaps: The official source discloses no aggregate or per-round financing amount, so amount remains unknown.
US$2.8B and RMB20B are alternative expressions of one valuation, not additive values.

titleZh: 优必选与日立推进 Walker S2 制造现场验证
summaryZh: 优必选于 2026 年 7 月 13 日披露，日立已将 Walker S2 引入部分制造环境，双方正在开展现场运行测试和应用场景验证。合作已进入实质验证阶段，但后续示范案例建设和部署推广仍是目标，不能视为已经完成规模部署。
excerpt: Hitachi has already introduced ... Walker S2, into select manufacturing environments ... to advance on-site operational testing and application scenario validation.

fields.deployment: 部分制造环境中的现场运行测试和应用场景验证

gaps: The page gives a publication date but no separate occurrence date.
No robot count, contract value, test start date, or sustained production-operation result is disclosed; broader deployment remains prospective.
